name: Glower
author: E. T. Carter
description: Storm cells at night merge into a great cumulonimbus whose anvil spreads over the upper frame, with slow violet and white glows swelling and wandering inside the billows, never flashing. A town strung along the plain burns the cloud bases sodium orange, thin rain hangs under the right-hand cell, and a flooded field below a dark ridge mirrors the glow.

params.label: Inner glow
params.effect: How strongly the glows inside the clouds light the billows around them.

params.label: Churn
params.effect: How fast the towers boil and the glows wander and swell.

params.label: Town light
params.effect: Warm sodium light of the town on the plain and on the cloud bases.
